<a id="program_entry"></a>
### [`program_entry`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L6) `$115A`

*label*

Program entry from the loader. It jumps to the cold start at $1aed.

<a id="move_return_flags"></a>
### [`move_return_flags`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L9) `$115D-$1175`

*data*

Move table, one byte per move $00-$18. Bit 7 keeps the input of the move; nonzero lets the move return to the stance by itself.

- **Referred to by:** [`move_update_state`](../fighter/fighter_moves.md#move_update_state) [`$2A70`](../../../../src/fighter/fighter_moves.asm#L126), [`move_anim_end`](../fighter/fighter_moves.md#move_anim_end) [`$2ACD`](../../../../src/fighter/fighter_moves.asm#L190)
